name: Hoth Set
description: The Hoth Set was the name given to a set of two weapons, an Arc Caster and a Pulse Blaster, utilized by the team of Jawa brothers known collectively as the Hunter Utooni that they could wield for the Hunters of the Outer Rim competition in the Grand Arena on the planet Vespaara as an alternative to their standard set. These snowy weathered weapons featured a white, tan, light gray, dark gray, and brown color scheme, with red buttons spread across, both wrapped with brown strands of cloth, and what appeared to be white wampa fur attached to the top of each. Additionally, the Arc Caster featured checkered tan cloth wrapping the bulk of the barrel while a necklace-like strand attached to a sharpened dangling bone-like object hung around the base.
